subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.**

The old man think his younger daughter was mocking him.
solution:
The correct answer is **"The old man think."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **'think'** should be in the past tense to match the subject** 'old man'** which is also in the past tense.
 
• It should be** 'thought'** instead of** 'think.'**
 
• This is an example of a subject-verb agreement error.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

**Correct sentence**: ***The old man thought**__ his younger daughter was mocking him. *
